review_text: Was excited to finally be in Singapore for a week. title: “Acceptable”
review_text:
his weekend past, I booked a 3 day 2 night stay to celebrate my husband’s birthday and our 2 year anniversary. Amara Sanctuary touts itself as a “luxury resort” with “5 star rooms”; this is grossly misstated in every conceivable manner, and false advertising on your part. 

1. Your buildings and infrastructure are so poorly maintained, some parts are downright dangerous. The floorboards in the Dream Pool and kids pool are rotting and loose; roofing above Sky Pool was flapping about in the wind; flooring in Shutters have expanded and bowed up; we observed algae and mould on ceilings and walls. Your lifts were a stone’s throw away from breaking down, and carpets felt musty and crummy. 

2. Our room was definitely not cleaned well – windows were spotty and stained, the bathtub was grimy, and the toilet bowl was broken. We had to constantly request for simple things, e.g. adequate drinking mugs and toiletries. 

3. TV froze many times, and half the channels offered were unavailable.

4. Housekeeping and maintenance protocols are not well thought through. As a “sanctuary”, is it wise to have your gardeners using leaf blowers at 8am on Saturday? Understand it was raining heavily the night before, but surely there are quieter methods of cleaning up, without disrupting the “intimate setting designed to relax and rejuvenate (y)our senses”.

5. As an attempt at service recovery, your manager offered us complimentary breakfast at Shutters. We begrudgingly accepted, hoping we would be able to end our experience on a good note. However, the breakfast buffet was such a letdown – the food quality was nonexistent and service standards were nowhere near what a 5 star hotel should boast. Some examples: barely cooked soggy bacon; watery congee; rock hard pancakes; sausage with more filler than meat; coffee machines not calibrated, thereby causing mugs to overflow.

The only commendable part came from how hard the crew worked at trying to fix and mend what is clearly severely broken. T

title: “Exceptional”
review_text: With two children, we stayed for one night in a room on the fourth floor with a balcony. The room was not small and very comfortable, and the minibar had snacks, tea, cola, and more. The balcony view was great, it was a sea view room, and we could see ships in the Strait of Malacca. The children were very happy swimming in the pool on the fourth floor. The hotel breakfast had good ingredients, a wide variety, and was very well-prepared, with attentive service from the restaurant staff. The hotel is a spacious garden with different levels of accommodation types and villas, several pools, and the architecture and landscaping have a strong Western influence, making it picturesque and suitable for vacationing. It’s a 10-minute walk from the MRT Yungbiou station, and less than 10 minutes downhill to Palawan Beach. It’s quieter compared to staying at Resorts World, and the location is slightly hidden but can be found using navigation. There is a YUE Chinese restaurant nearby. The meals inside the hotel are also very good, and hotel guests receive a small discount. Before checking in and after checking out, we stored our luggage at the front desk, went to enjoy the sledding and Universal Studios, and then came back to collect our luggage.

title: “Dirty room, with bugs, and damaged furniture”
review_text:
Went here for my engagement and am very disappointed. Staff from the get go were rude and unfriendly. No one bothered to help with) bags and there were no welcomes or smiles.

The room itself was dirty, with stains on the walls and showers and chipped marble in the bathroom. There was hair in the sink that wasn't cleaned as well.

The shower drain didn't work, so when we showered it flooded into the restroom as well. Small flies also kept flying out of the drain.

The worst part was at night, we spotted what seemed to look like a bedbug in the room. A mosquito or other bugs are fine--you're surrounded by greenery, but this was unacceptable.

When we told the staff, instead of apologizing and trying to make it right, they offered to clean and send someone to declog the shower. In any other hotel, we would have been shown a new room, if not upgraded or comped. 

Instead we were given a room on the first floor (we were on the 4th). Luckily the drains worked and there were no signs of bedbugs.

For a hotel I spent nearly $400 a night for, and this being my engagement stay, this experience was horrible. Take your money elsewhere.

title: “Memorial stay”
review_text:
Review for PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay

During my 3 days, 2 nights staycation at PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, I celebrated both my birthday and Christmas with a small in-room gathering, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional.

From the very beginning, we had multiple requests that required coordination across different hotel departments to properly organize and kick-start the occasion. Despite the heavy traffic and peak festive period, the service delivery was outstanding and exceeded all expectations.

The most impactful and memorable contribution came from the One Connect department. I would like to specially commend Ms. Linn, whose dedication, attentiveness, and consistent follow-ups ensured that every request was executed smoothly. Her ability to coordinate seamlessly despite the busy holiday season truly made a meaningful difference to our stay.

Zana from the One Connect team was also incredibly helpful, assisting with our daily requests and proactively following up on arrangements—often revisiting items that were initially not possible and finding ways to make them happen later. This level of care and persistence made us feel genuinely important and valued as guests.

In addition, Malini from One Connect stood out for her exceptional attention to detail and forward-thinking approach. She demonstrated the ability to anticipate guest needs rather than simply respond to requests. For example, when I requested a laundry bag, she thoughtfully prompted whether we would also require the laundry form, which we had initially overlooked. She confirmed this proactively instead of merely following instructions, and this level of initiative made me feel truly cared for and prioritized.

What stood out most was the seamless communication between guest requests, internal departments, and final execution. Everything was well-coordinated, reliable, and stress-free I had complete confidence in the team’s ability to deliver.

Even when there was a slight miscommunication regarding my birthday cake, the hotel handled it with grace and professionalism. The team followed up with a handwritten letter delivered to my room to express their apologies and appreciation, and later arranged for a replacement cake to be sent up at my own convenience. This thoughtful recovery turned a small hiccup into a truly memorable birthday-and-Christmas celebration.

The Concierge team also deserves special praise. They were friendly, proactive, and extremely easy to communicate with. As I had many bags and gifts, moving around Suntec and places like The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands would have been difficult but thanks to their efficient coordination, I could store my luggage safely and travel worry-free even after check-out. Their teamwork, readiness to assist, and clear communication made logistics effortless.

The Front Office team further elevated the experience. Check-in was smooth and flawless, handled by multiple hostesses who ensured everything was convenient and welcoming. Lydia was especially helpful in storing both my personal cake and the hotel’s complimentary cake, coordinating closely with One Connect to ensure everything was delivered at the correct timing. Her attention to detail made my birthday celebration effortless.

Casta stood out for her swift, decisive, and purposeful actions. Every step she took was efficient and intentional, reflecting true five-star service no wasted movements, no hiccups, just seamless execution. Her tone and professionalism clearly conveyed that our stay was important.

Lastly, Rosy assisted me with revalidating my room key and extending my late check-out. Her attention to detail, security awareness, and quick follow-ups were extremely impressive. She consistently checked, updated, and confirmed everything efficiently, which gave me great confidence in the hotel’s operational standards.

Overall, every department worked together to make my stay memorable from start to finish. PARKROYAL COLLECTION

My wife and I stayed there for her birthday, I had made a prior request for a cake as a nice gesture to my wife. (however no cakes were given, but I had already had a friend bring over a cake just in case, since some hotels just give a slice and we were expecting guests) 

We had 2 other families who were joining us for a couple of hours, mainly for the kids to have fun by the pool.  The pool's condition was very bad. Though it looked clean from a glance there were algae built ups on the floor of the pool. 
 
The series of events that followed due the poor maintenance of the pool was disastrous.

The first was my friend's daughter she slipped on the floor of the baby pool, however since she was wearing her life jacket it prevented her from hitting her head as she fell backwards. However her mother was not that lucky, within a few mins later she slipped (on a different spot) and hit her head on the floor. She had a very bad swelling, as we rushed to attend to her, my wife tried to call the hotel reception from the room phone. 

The hotel phone was not working! One of other friend's googled, Amara Sanctuary phone number to get hold of the reception. 

Yes hotel security and a few other staffs came to check on us eventually. But the fact that the hotel phone was not working was a serious matter. 

We later tried to order room service for the kids, and had requested for Ice for my friend's swelling.  The calls were not attended. We kept trying the numbers to connect to the concierge or reception, as no one was answering the in room service line.  Even the concierge and reception only attended the calls after 2 or 3 attempts 

Overall we are very disappointed with the service rendered to us during the stay. Yes the hotel is nice and spacious, but based on the lack of maintenance of the pool and poor service we will not return.

In the end, we did not even utilise the jacuzzi because it was too cold to soak in and it was not bubbling at all. I feel for the price, they should at least make sure that the jacuzzi was working, and not just tell customers that it has always been like that and to just accept it.

A request for a late check out was also not entertained.

I would say give this hotel a miss - there is plenty of competition these days.

title: “Not up to standard of a 5-star hotel”
review_text:
TL;DR
Aged furnishings in the rooms are not maintained well. Breakfast buffet was mediocre at best. Not worth the price we paid; I would not expect this of a 5-star hotel.

Stayed in a deluxe king room. The room as a whole was generally clean. But the infrastructure was poorly maintained. The bathroom was the worst part.

The shower holder was broken.
The shower door also did not close fully, which meant that water escaped and flooded the main area of the bathroom.
Worse, the water did not flow into the drain, but pooled next to the toilet bowl due to how the tiles were sloped.
The smooth marble bathroom tiles were extremely slippery when wet.

The sink was built on top of a wooden frame, which was mouldy, chipped, and peeling; splinters of wood jutted out.

The drainage mechanism in the bath tub was not working.

The air conditioner could not be controlled, regardless of what was set on the interface.

The cups in the mini pantry could not be removed from the drawer - they were too thick to fit through the gap of the drawer. We couldn't make tea/coffee in the room.

Breakfast buffet was generic and bland. The Asian food on offer was (surprisingly) bad, especially the hot noodle station. If breakfast is not included in your deal, don't bother paying for it.

The location of the hotel is very strategic. Though it is located at the heart of CBD, the access is great, from buses to MRT. We also can easily get food as there are lots of eatery available nearby which open until past midnight.

title: “Great stay at Beverly Hotels Elements! ”
review_text:
Stayed from Oct 3-6. Paid around PHP7,000+ per night. Will definitely stay here again! 

Room is new & pristine! Loved it! Hallways smell nice. Room has shelves, safe, and mini ref. No table and chairs. Hotel provides toilet paper, towels, body wash, shampoo, sanitary bags, shower caps, & dental kits. No soap bars just the body wash. 

Room is small if you have luggages. Carry-on luggage (bearable enough to move around), Big luggage (will be a challenge). The shower and toilet area has no divider so water splashes a bit everywhere but floor dries up quickly. There is a bidet!!! 

Location is great! A 5 min. walk from Lavender station (which connects easily to other train lines). Lots of eateries (old chang kee, local hawker, 7eleven, toast box, mcdonalds, burger king, food stalls/complex) around. Fairprice supermarket is just across the hotel. 

Read other reviews about the AC. It's not that noisy. More like a white noise. Soft hum. For us, it was normal. 

Staff answered our queries and accommodated our requests swiftly! Thank you IK for all your help! You're very nice & charming! The hotel required a SGD50 security deposit which was returned after our stay.

title: “Looks promising but does not deliver ”
review_text: A lovely resort that is unfortunately ruined by mismanagement. Resort itself is absolutely lovely but the experience unfortunately takes away from looks and feel of the resort. We had booked a room with access to a pool. At check in we had to wait 45 minutes for the room to prepared (even though we had arrived after 3pm) - in itself this is not a problem, but we were not offered any apologies or refreshments or taken to the pool while we waited, the staff stood around on their phones and eventually we had to check in.  When we did get invited to the room the staff were still cleaning (not the housekeepers fault) but then the housekeeper and the staff member who brought us started to argue and then they phoned reception again and started to argue (presumably about letting us in the room without it being finished). However, we then had a note in the room saying that access to the pool (the only selling point of the room) was not available due to a private event. This was not mentioned on the website or checkin and no compensation or any sort of alternative was offered.  Finally a member of staff appeared to apologise, but this should be standard front of house training rather than us waiting over an hour for something to apologise for this mess. We asked for an upgrade that was accommodated to a room with jacuzzi access but I doubt any sort of upgrade would have been offered if we had not asked. We had been given absolutely no information about where to get breakfast, or any facilities (I.e the gym or spa - even the location of those things) in the one night we were there. In sum, they need to train their staff to a much higher standard in order to deserve any sort of five star rating - I have received kindness, warmth and basic information about hotel facilities in most places I have ever stayed in, but you would expect this as a given in a five star resort. The service we received was akin to a two star but with a massive price tag. I also left an item of clothing in the room and phoned for them to check for it while I was still in Singapore so I could pick it up.  I received no call back and I eventually phoned to confirm they had not found it after I had flown back to HK (as I assumed they didn’t have it) and I was told they did have it.. they just had not phoned to tell me. I have been asked to pay for shipping (fine) but also a 20% surcharge (again fine) but given I had asked them to let me know asap so I could pick it up while I was still in the country you would expect for them to perhaps waive the surcharge or at least apologise that they didn’t contact me (no apology). I have not received my item of clothing I would be shocked if they have actually posted it at this point given the level of mismanagement.  If you are prepared to stay in a five star resort in Sentosa, save yourself and go elsewhere.

The newly opened hotel has everything one would want in a hotel — from super tidy rooms to short-distant metro stations, to grocery stores and food spots that are open past midnight.

You can find FairPrice right opposite to the hotel and Seven-11 (opened 24/7) right opposite to FairPrice. You can also find plenty of food spots just a few blocks away, including McDonald’s, Burger King, and Subway, which are all halal friendly.

The major tourist spots are not too far from the hotel and it is easy to get around. Lavendar MRT Station is at 3 mins walk. Bendemeer MRT Station is at 6 mins walk.

The hotel is super tidy and always smells nice. The staff is friendly and always helpful. Special shoutout to Clarice for always being there and helping me with the know-how of the city!

Although you may find the rooms quite small with no good views out the window, they are all pretty well maintained as well.

Regarding the noticeable improvements that the hotel has room for:

The rooms are a bit pricey and pretty small. There are no side tables, no desks or chairs. So you only get to eat food and work from the beds provided.

The TVs only have a few channels, but having support for YouTube had me covered with entertainment for the most part.

The views right outside the windows are not very attractive but I liked that the large windows let the sunlight in.

Overall, my stay at Beverly Hotel Elements has been amazing and I’d definitely stay there again with no second thought.

title: “Anniversary Stay”
review_text:
Club Lounge
Pros: 
Check in was pleasant, served by Kate. Kate gave a late check out till 1pm, which was great. There were hiccups initially, wrong room type was given when I entered the room. I went back down to the reception, Kate immediately rectified the issue. She mentioned that room was not ready. I didn't mind waiting since I came early. I went to check out the lounge. Ariane & Alya (pardon me if i misspelled your names ladies) were ready with their biggest smile to welcome me. When I mentioned my Urban suite room is not ready, Ariane expedite it at her own accord & passed me my room card. I was impressed. Alya showed me to my seat & shared with me the spread they have and timing infos for breakfast afternoon tea & evening cocktail. When I requested for watermelon juice, Alya checked if there was and happy to say it will be served. Bala served my drink with friendliness and professionalism. When it was time for me to leave (apparently I was the only 1 left in the lounge), the lounge staff bade me gdbye. Ariane even asked if I need to be accompanied to my room. I was really pampered there and I think the service was marvellous.
Please convey my thank you and kudos to these staff mentioned.

Cons:
I decided to drop by to the lounge again abit before afternoon tea. I went with my husband this time round, telling him the great service I experienced a few hours ago. Unfortunately, service was different from my previous visit.
There was a small-sized lady staff at the counter. I believe she was a Filipino. She was busy talking on her handphone and didn't stop to welcome us in. We chose our own seats. We were waiting to be asked what drinks we would like but no one came to us. The staff didn't come over and was still on her handphone. We hang awhile for 10 minutes before leaving. We walked past the counter but we still were not acknowledged. Total disappointment.

Rooms
Pros:
Our Urban Suite Room 2020 was amazing. Size was good, view was fantastic. The complimentary snacks from the picnic basket was awesome. Though Marina Parkroyal did not set up any anniversary surprise for us (which I mentioned to Rachel), the picnic snack was suffice.

Cons:
I just came back to my room that afternoon and was changing. I heard the doorbell rang a few times. I was busy getting dressed when I heard the door opened. I was lucky I was in a suite, hence I wasn't dressing up openly and was in my bedroom. By the time I walked in with my shawl half done around my head to the living room, 2 staff were walking in right in the middle of the living room. I was so shocked. At least, give it 'hello' and I could have replied to give me a minute. Two ladies I believe were Vietnamese or Burmese (Myanmar). They asked if I needed anything. I just checked in like 3 hrs ago. I told them not to enter if I didn't open the door. I was very frustrated with their service & attitude.
I have been to many good chain hotels around the world and this was the first time I encountered such an experience. Usual practice for housekeeping staff will ring the bell and if there is no answer, they will hang a note outside the room informing guests of their names & that they came by for housekeeping service. If guests need their service, we can always give housekeeping a ring.  Even without the Do Not Disturb sign on, housekeeping staff usually don't go in, especially when guests just checked in. I put on the sign for DND all the way during my stay after that fateful incident.

If Marina Parkroyal (which is a good brand of hotel), does not or has not adopt such a practice, please start soon. 
I felt very angry and frustrated that my privacy in that suite was invaded. 

I hope the hotel manager, Mr Phil Smith, can look into this serious matter.
I would have given this property 101% awesomeness if not for these issues mentioned. I am sure my feedback will be reviewed for training and better quality of staff. 
Thank you.

title: “Looking for 5-star standard, Marina Mandarin is not”
review_text:
I stayed for 3 nights from 25 to 28 June 2017. Because of my need to rush for another appointment, I went to the hotel to "register" at about 8am.  During the registration, I informed the reception that my wife will be coming in late at about 11pm. To ensure easy access for my wife, I gave the reception the full details. I was also told to get the access card for my room from the concierge when I check in later. After the registration, instead of getting someone to handle by luggage, the reception asked me to go down to level 1 and passed it to the concierge myself. Is this 5-star hotel standard?? 

When I return to the hotel at about 6.30pm, I approached the concierge to get my access card. It was not ready. I had to wait for the staff to start programming and to make matter worse, I had to inform the staff again about the arrangement for my wife. Yes, the staff had to ask for my wife's details again even though it was given in the morning.  Is this a 5-star standard?

After the ordeal, I was looking forward to have my red wine in my room.  To my horror, this 5-star hotel does not provide wine glass in the room. I had to call the housekeeping to request for it, which took them about 15 minutes to deliver. When they did deliver the wine glasses, I had a rule shock to see how minuscule the wine glasses were. 

After a drink in that tiny wine glass, I proceeded to take a shower.  I wanted to find a shaver in the bathroom to shave, but could not find one. I later learnt from the duty manager, this 5-star does not provide shaver unless you call the housekeeping to arrange for one.

My worst experience was when I had to get another access key for my room. I went to level 4 which is the reception level. There was a queue with about 5 guests. While waiting in the queue, I noticed a staff in uniform was talking to one of the 3 receptionists. Even though she did notice that there was a queue, she continued to engage in a discussion with the receptionist.  I believe for a fiv

title: “A Property that is Struggling”
review_text: Was our first time in Amara, and we were excited to try the Couple Suite with direct access to pool for romantic escape from the kids. We arrived at the property and told we were upgraded to a "Family Room." When we told them we didn't want the upgrade, and were happy with the room we booked, they told us that the room is not available, and that we actually don't have much of a choice on the room. They could have communicated this earlier and we could have had the option of cancelling our booking and going somewhere else -- so we felt hijacked from the get-go. The same receptionist (and there were only 2 receptions on desk) who checked us in was the same person who drove the buggy to our room, which tipped us off that the property is probably severely understaffed.  We tried calling in room service, and the line kept on ringing, no response on the other end. After 45 minutes of trying, we finally decided to walk up to the restaurant. Again, looked understaffed, which explained the lack of response. Thankfully, we were able to put our orders in, and it arrived within 45 minutes. The next morning, we were excited to get some pool time thinking that might save the experience. We reached the pool and it was a mess -- empty champagne bottle and flutes, crumpled tissue papers, and masks strewn in the lounge area, no clean towels, no attendant. The wood planks by the pool were not even, with some coming loose, and we could clearly rusty nails. It didn't look and feel safe and clean. We tidied up a corner for ourselves, and in the 2 hours we were baking in the sun, did not see a single attendant. Was disappointed with the whole experience. The property felt run down and ill-maintained, and the staff felt overworked.  Felt so sorry for the staff, and was a horrible experience at a 5-star price point.

Breakfast is very ordinary.  Not so much there.  Good thing I only got one day of breakfast for my three night stay.

Room is generally clean.  I'm not sure about the carpet but I don't feel anything grainy if I walk barefoot.  The bathroom is sparkling clean and well maintained.

I'll definitely stay here again in case I will attend another conference in the area.

title: “Staycation”
review_text:
We completed a 2-day, 1-night family staycation at Amara Sanctuary Resort with our 3-year-old and overall found it to be a reasonably valued option on Sentosa, with several areas that could be strengthened to enhance the guest experience.

From a location perspective, the property requires either taking the bus from RWS or waiting for the resort’s shuttle service, which offers limited drop-off points. Streamlining transport connectivity would significantly improve convenience for families with young children.

The room was clean and comfortably spacious. The only drawback was a noticeable musky smell in the toilet, which detracted slightly from the overall comfort level.

Facilities-wise, the kids’ pool is situated quite far from the main lobby and requires walking outdoors to access it. The area was not staffed, and the pool contained many dried leaves, creating a less-than-ideal first impression in terms of hygiene and upkeep.

Dining at the hotel restaurant was acceptable. Breakfast variety was decent though not exceptional, but the provision of food vouchers during our stay was a thoughtful gesture. The restaurant staff were exceptionally friendly and welcoming—truly a highlight of the service experience. In contrast, service at the lobby could be improved; check-in and check-out processes required considerable waiting time.

Despite these gaps, the stay was still worthwhile given that the price point is one of the most reasonable on Sentosa Island. With enhancements to transport, pool maintenance, and front-of-house efficiency, the overall guest experience could be significantly elevated.

title: “Excellent stay at Amara sanctuary resort Sentosa”
review_text:
We recently stayed at Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa as a family with young children and parents, and our experience was truly enjoyable. Here’s a summary of our stay:

Good Points:

Cleanliness: The resort maintained impeccable cleanliness throughout, from the rooms to the common areas. This made our stay very comfortable, especially with young children.

Courteous Staff: The staff were exceptionally polite and attentive. They went out of their way to ensure we felt welcomed and that our needs were met.

Room Size: The Deluxe Room we stayed in was spacious and well-appointed, providing ample space for our family to relax.

Sky Pool Views: The rooftop Sky Pool offered breathtaking views – an absolute highlight of our stay. It was a serene spot to unwind while taking in the stunning surroundings.

Convenient Transportation: The resort offers a free bus service, which was incredibly handy for getting around Sentosa. Additionally, its proximity to the Sentosa bus service made exploring the island even more convenient.

Overall, Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa exceeded our expectations with its combination of great service, comfortable accommodations, and excellent amenities. It’s an ideal choice for families and anyone looking for a relaxing getaway on Sentosa Island. We would love to return in the future!

title: “Our Honest Staycation Review ”
review_text:
We booked the Family Room at Amara Sanctuary, expecting a fun and comfortable staycation for the kids. The room comes with a large bed (either queen or king, I honestly forgot), and two single beds for the children. But unfortunately, the experience didn’t start off well.

🛏️ Room Condition:
	•	The aircon wasn’t cold, even after we left it running for over an hour.
	•	The room had a stale, musty smell.
	•	The wardrobe door was loose, and felt like it could fall off anytime.
	•	Bathroom floor was badly stained, and the drain cover was half open when we entered.
	•	The tap at the sink was faulty, causing water to splash everywhere when turned on.

🏊 Pool Facilities:

We brought the kids to the children’s pool (Dream Pool), but it was visibly dirty and poorly maintained, so we left shortly after. We then tried the rooftop pool, which was cleaner—until we saw an unsupervised boy washing his slippers in the pool. That was a no-go for us, and we left again.

🛠️ Service Recovery:

After we returned to the room and found the aircon still not working, we called for assistance. The technician came to fix it, but the room remained warm. Eventually, the manager came to inspect the room. He was apologetic and aware of the room’s condition.

We were then upgraded to a newly renovated suite, which was a huge improvement. The room was clean, modern, and much more comfortable. The pool in the suite area was clean, though the jacuzzi wasn’t working.

⸻

✅ Overall Thoughts:
	•	Old wing: needs serious maintenance
	•	Cleanliness: inconsistent, especially pool areas
	•	Service: polite and responsive, with a good recovery
	•	New wing: much better and actually enjoyable

title: “Good ambience ”
review_text:
I recently enjoyed a delightful one-night staycation at the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay for my birthday on the 11th, and I must say the experience was highly satisfactory. The hotel provided an exceptional urban escape, blending beautiful design with thoughtful service.
🛏️ Room & Comfort
The room itself was spacious and well-appointed, perfect for a solo stay. The balcony with a nice harbour view was a fantastic feature, providing a relaxing backdrop to my stay. The king-size bed was quite comfy and ensured a good rest, although it was a little high for a shorter person!
✨ Service & Personalized Touches
The level of personalized service truly stood out. I greatly appreciated the hotel's effort in providing a complimentary small sweet cake treat and a cute folded towel in the shape of an elephant. The accompanying birthday wish card was a very sweet gesture, making my birthday feel genuinely celebrated.
The staff interaction was also commendable. The desk staff member who asked "how's the stay so far?" demonstrated a good, attentive attitude.
🧹 Cleanliness and Minor Notes
Cleanliness throughout the room was acceptable. The only minor issue I encountered was that the bathroom door knob was not able to lock. However, as I was staying alone, this was not a major concern.

Overall, I was highly satisfied with my stay. From the spacious room and lovely view to the very thoughtful birthday amenities and friendly staff, the experience was wonderful. I definitely plan to frequent the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay again!

title: “A nice getaway missing the "heartware"”
review_text:
I came across numerous negative reviews of this resort on various portals and was apprehensive about my stay but I was greeted with a clean room w/o any major issues. Aircon was working fine and no leakages/mould in the bathroom (these were mainly the issues reported by other travellers). The facilities, however, are clearly dated e.g. the office chair inside the room was badly peeling.

Sentosa is a great getaway venue and Amara certainly had the vibes for a relaxing time. Unfortunately though, the staff were clearly lacking the software needed for the hospitality industry. E.g. when I arrived, I was carrying my sleeping toddler and was standing in line to check in. Imagine having to stand around with heavy bags and a 13kg weight on your shoulder. The staff paid no attention to me, not once offering me any assistance. A couple arrived shortly after me and coincidentally one of the check in counters cleared up. Before I could step forward, the couple did and were promptly served by the staff so I had to continue standing in line to wait carrying all the weight. It took maybe another 10 - 15 mins before I was finally served. 

Only one of the staff bothered to greet me when crossing paths which is very unexpected. I've had much better experiences are other 4/5* establishments. Considering how many other hotels there are on Sentosa island, this would be one of my least fav choices going forward.

So yes, I would recommend this resort because of its idyllic setting and decently clean and good size rooms/bathrooms but don't expect too much service while you are there.

title: “가성비이긴 한데”
review_text:
아쉬운 측면이 있습니다. 

1. 숙소
저는 1인실을 썼는데, 굉장히 좁은 사이즈입니다. 캡슐호텔보다 조금 나은 수준이라고 생각하시면 됩니다. 여행객이시라면, 계획을 짜실 때 이곳에서 숙박하시다가 마지막날 즈음 조금 더 좋은 곳에서 마무리하시는 걸 추천합니다. 

2. 시설
에어컨 필터나 정수기 필터가 잘 교체되고 있지는 않은 것 같습니다. 아직은 신축이라 괜찮은데 조금 더 시간이 지나면 필터의 청결함은 보장 못할 것 같습니다. 현재 정수기는 괜찮다고 쳐도, 에어컨은 온도를 조금만 올려도 곰팡이 냄새가 납니다. 

수압은 싱가포르 자체가 수압이 낮은 국가라 감안하면 보통입니다. 다만, 온수는 샤워실에만 나오고, 비누가 비치되어 있지 않습니다. 제가 썼던 방은 세면대 위생이 조금 별로였습니다. 


3. 직원
직원 응대는 굉장히 친절합니다. 다만 첫날 체크인할때 보증금 50불을 내야 합니다. 

4.위치
우선, 이 지역 자체가 인도인 거주지 근처라 인도인들이 굉장히 많이 보입니다. (물론 주위에 큰 호텔도 있어 관광객도 많음). 다만 mrt 라벤더 역이 지근거리라 mrt를 주로 이용하실 분에게는 괜찮은 선택지인 것 같습니다. 

5. 편의시설
숙소 앞에 세븐일레븐과 페어프라이스가 있습니다.  그리고 역 입구쪽에 길거리 음식 파는 곳, 맥도날드가 있고 뒤쪽엔 토스트박스가 있긴 한데 저는 잘 이용을 안했습니다. 

조금만 걸어서 나가시면(5분) 뒷편 아페리아몰(aperia mall)이 있는데 오히려 저는 이곳에서 이것저것 해결하시는 것을 추천합니다. 한인 식당(분식집)도 괜찮았고, Tim ho wan 이라는 홍콩 음식점도 괜찮았습니다. 몰 자체가 꺠끗하고 음식도 괜찮았으며, 스타벅스가 있습니다. 한인마트도 조그마하게 있습니다. 

총평하자면, 시설이나 위치 면에서 아쉬운 게 있어도 나름 적응하면 편하게 지내다 올 수 있는 곳입니다. 근데 다음에 싱가포르 여행을 간다면 돈 조금 더 보태더 더 좋은 숙소 갈 것 같아요.

title: “Very disappointed with the service”

Shouldn't the staff who checked us in not tagged it to our room? 30 minutes after the call, someone finally brought the bag up.
In the evening, we called for some ice and a bottle opener. To our surprise, this 5-star hotel required us to go down to get them ourselves. Short handed or staff that couldn't be bothered, we really can't tell anymore at this point.

It was our anniversary but we encountered the worst service and experience we ever had. We will definitely not consider another stay at Amara.

We had a lovely stay at Parkroyal Marina Bay, and overall it was a very comfortable and pleasant experience for our family.
We really loved the ambiance — the lobby with its lush greenery feels calming and refreshing, and Peppermint restaurant is very spacious and well laid out. The Urban Garden outside adds a nice eco-friendly touch that makes the whole space feel thoughtful and relaxing.
The pool isn’t very big, and it would be amazing if the grassy patch nearby could be expanded into a larger pool area (or even turned into a jacuzzi!), but despite that, the elevated pool level offers beautiful views of the surrounding buildings. At night especially, it feels cosy and almost magical.
Our room was generously sized, and the daybed made a huge difference — my husband, two kids, and I all slept comfortably without needing extra beds. The bathroom was reasonably spacious as well. Location-wise, it’s excellent — being so close to Marina Square with endless food options, and Suntec City nearby, made everything very convenient.
One downside was the TV system, which wasn’t very user-friendly. We couldn’t connect to YouTube, Netflix, or Disney+, which would have been nice, especially with kids.
That said, room service portions were generous and satisfying, and housekeeping did a great job keeping everything clean and pleasant throughout our stay.
Overall, a great stay with a lovely atmosphere, comfortable rooms, and an excellent location. We’d be happy to return.

I am a solo traveler from Korea. 
I came to Singapore with just a small carry-on suitcase. 

I didn’t need a spacious and fancy room. However, I also didn't want a dirty and unreliable room. On the other hand, going to an expensive hotel felt like such a waste. 

Then I found this hotel, which offered a private room for a very reasonable price of about 90,000 won per night, so I chose this hotel. 

In conclusion, it was a great choice. 

The hotel was easily accessible from MRT Lavender and Bendemeer stations, and there are Fairprice and hawker centers nearby. These facilities are very helpful in saving travelers' budgets.

title: “Disappointing Experience During Our Staycation at Amara Sentosa (21–22 Nov 2025)”
review_text:
We’re disappointed to share that our recent staycation at Amara Sentosa from 21 to 22 November 2025 was marred by an unfortunate experience. After dining at the hotel’s breakfast buffet, both my daughter and I began feeling unwell shortly afterward, experiencing severe diarrhoea and vomiting. While we cannot confirm the exact cause, the timing was concerning enough that we felt it was important to highlight this for the hotel to review its food handling and dining practices so that other guests do not encounter a similar issue.

This was especially disheartening because we have been loyal customers of the hotel. I had even written a complimentary review about our previous stay, praising the service and hospitality. This time, however, we were shocked by the decline in service quality—from the front desk to the restaurant.

When we started feeling sick, we called the front desk to request a slightly later checkout beyond 12pm so we could rest and recover a little before leaving. Unfortunately, the female staff member we spoke with rejected the request without consideration, even after we explained that we had become unwell after breakfast. Her response felt extremely cold and dismissive, and we were told that there was nothing she could do. No concern at all was shown for our wellbeing. As of the evening of 23 November, my daughter was still experiencing vomiting and severe diarrhoea.

During breakfast on 22 November, we were also seated at a table for two in an area where the floor was still extremely wet from the previous day’s rain. We were told we needed to sit there due to crowd control, even though dry tables were available. The restaurant staff simply smiled and said, “be careful of the wet floor,” even though the situation was clearly unsafe. We did not want this incident to ruin our morning, so we reluctantly sat at the table, but walking required extreme caution. This was an indoor dining area, and as an older adult with a fall risk, being placed on a wet floor felt unsafe and inconsiderate. The staff’s manner came across as dismissive despite the polite smile, and it did not reflect the level of service we had previously enjoyed. On top of that, we even had to endure the noise from the same staff giving a loud training lecture while openly criticising her junior staff members nearby, which added to the discomfort of the dining experience.

Overall, we were deeply disappointed—by the lack of empathy at the front desk, the quality of the expensive BBQ dinner, the food voucher that felt unusable due to the many terms and conditions, and the poor service at the restaurant. After being loyal customers for years, this stay fell far below our expectations. We sincerely hope the hotel takes these concerns seriously so that future guests do not experience the same issues.

title: “Great Budget-Friendly Stay for Short Trips”
review_text:
Other than the size of the room, this hotel is great. The bed is comfortable, the water is warm, and the shower is nice. They provide a hot and cold water dispenser for guests on every floor. They also offer early check-in, and the check-in and check-out process is smooth and easy. If you’re traveling to Singapore for a short stay, I recommend this hotel. It’s close to many convenience stores, cafés, and food courts, as well as the MRT Lavender station and Kallang bus stops.

They have a special lane for wheelchairs and strollers in case the lift doesn’t fit them. You can also park them near the lift since they cannot fit inside the room.

The lift, room, and even the hall are clean. The most wonderful feature is that the room has a large, clear glass window overlooking a nearby park and soccer field. This helps prevent the space from feeling too claustrophobic, even though the room is quite small.

I traveled with a child under 8 years old, so the space was fine. However, for older kids, the room would definitely feel too small. I had two medium suitcases, and they fit perfectly. But if you have more luggage or larger suitcases, it could be a problem.

Overall, it’s a great option for short stays and budget travelers.

We recently stayed at Amara Sanctuary Resort Sentosa, and while there were some positive aspects, a few issues left us somewhat disappointed.
First, the location of the resort is fantastic—nestled in the lush greenery of Sentosa, offering a peaceful retreat with easy access to the island's attractions. However, one significant downside for us was the food. Unfortunately, the resort does not offer Halal options, which is not ideal for Muslim guests like us. This made it challenging for us to find suitable dining options on the premises. We had to rely on external restaurants, which was inconvenient.
Additionally, we found the internet to be a bit slow, which made it difficult to stay connected, especially when trying to work or stream content.
Despite these issues, the resort itself was beautiful, and the overall experience was pleasant. However, we would recommend that the management consider providing Halal food options to better accommodate all guests.

Although we had already paid for the hotel (including breakfast) at the time of booking, we were asked for a deposit at check-in. They properly processed the refund at checkout, which was great.

title: “A great hotel to explore Singapore”
review_text:
We booked 7 nights for our recent visit to Singapore at the Parkroyal Collection Marina Bay and we’re glad we did.  It was the ideal hotel for us in many ways.  

The location of the property is ideal. it’s just a short walk to the Esplanade for great views, bike rentals and walks around Singapore; it’s a short walk to Metro stations (though we used Grab cars for our transport); and there is the Marina Square mall literally next door with a large number of food options (and retail stores).

The hotel was very clean and well appointed and our view was spectacular!  We booked a King room with Marina Bay view.  The hotel lobby is grand and gorgeous and we were there end of November so the lobby was decorated for Christmas.  We didn’t take the opportunity for a swim but did visit the pool which was lovely.  It’s an outdoor pool with a kids' pool surrounded by the Singapore skyline.  Another little but much appreciated feature was the filtered water dispenser in the bathroom!

Should we visit Singapore again, we will definitely choose this hotel for our lodging.

title: “History meets Resort”
review_text:
The charm of colonial buildings are what  excites us as we travelled on a buggy ride to our room. We had a Courtyard Suite with Jacuzzi & it was beautiful from the white-gated front porch to the four-poster bed to the jacuzzi at the backyard. There's even a bunker in front which the kids explored. 

We asked for 2 baby cots becaus3 we have twins & the cots fit nicely in the spacious room. Told me at 1st that the cots were meant for under 1-year-olds though. But my 19-month olds had more than ample space & slept the whole night through in those cots. I think a 2-year-old can still fit nicely. Much safer too than rolling off the bed. 

We ordered room service for breakfast & it was a lovely meal which came rather fast.

We had a nature walk & saw peacocks, squirrels & cockatoos. Kids truly love the wide spaces for walks & also the buggy rides.

However, granted that the resort is on historical site & in nature, we don't think the cleanliness of the room needs to be a 'rustic'. Nothing that a small toothbrush can't clean for the stains in the sink, below the tap, on parts of the floor of the jacuzzi shower area. I think for the price, a little bit more attention to cleanliness would be desired. When we stayed at Lexis Hibiscus, it was dust-free, sand-free eventhough it was on-water & breezy. 

Other than that, we had a lovely stay & thank you for the pretty, little birthday cake for my Husband.

title: “Paid Premium for a Villa, Received Unacceptable Service – Completely Disappointing”
review_text:
I booked and paid a premium for the One-Bedroom Villa at Amara Sentosa to celebrate my son’s birthday, expecting a quality experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the most disappointing stays we’ve ever had.

From check-in, it was obvious the property was severely understaffed. We made more than 50 unanswered calls to reception throughout our stay, with no one available to assist. There was also no return buggy service due to no one answering the reception calls, forcing our guests to walk to the carpark on their own, from the villa which is faraway from the carpark. 

I personally informed staff (Shafiq) at check-in of our needs such aa extra chairs, water, and ice cubes, and he wrote everything down right in front of me,  but nothing was ever arranged. 
Later, when we used the villa’s hair dryer, the entire unit lost power. - lights, air-con, tv, all were shut off. We tried calling reception for help repeatedly, but no one answered, and my husband had to walk all the way to the lobby to get assistance.

To make matters worse, a birthday cake delivery arranged for 7:30 p.m. was misplaced by the hotel, causing unnecessary confusion. One of our guests had to personally locate and collect the cake instead of the hotel staff.

After all that, the hotel tried to impose a $300 “excessive trash” charge - something that was never communicated before or during check-in. Despite multiple emails, clear evidence, and even setting deadlines, the hotel has failed to respond for over a week.

For a stay that cost a premium, the service level and lack of accountability are completely unacceptable. This experience not only ruined our celebration but also embarrassed us in front of our guests.

Strongly not recommended until the property addresses its serious service and communication issues.

title: “Good hotel. Close to Universal Studio”
review_text:
The hotel is located about 700 meters from Universal Studio. If you're looking for an affordable hotel that is close to USS then this is it!

Breakfast cost was included; has a good variety. Ranging from Japanese, Chinese noodles, Malay nasi lamak to Western bacon, eggs hash browns and cereals. Lots of dessert and drink options too. However if you want to save money and not include the breakfast option, there is a Malaysian Street Food cafe located close to USS (500 meter walk) that has food & drink ranging from $8-15 per person.

Transport between hotel and main island. The hotel has a shuttle bus service that runs every 30mins to and from the hotel and vivocity/habour front MRT (train station).

To get to the hotel, I'd strongly advise visitors to get to the hotel via taxi/grab car.  It's a 500 meter walk from yhe monorail station and there's a 75meter slope to get to the hotel. No problem if you take the shuttle bus or taxi though. 

Cleanliness. There were a few stain marks in the bath tub and the wooden shelves in the bathroom showed signs of water damage (or extended exposure to moisture). The hotel needs to look at the upkeep of the place. 

Lighting. The lifts are quite dark at night and there is insufficient lighting along the corridors. 

General stay at the hotel is comfortable and staff are helpful and friendly. Guests staying on levels 1 and 2 have to check that the room windows are locked otherwise it can be accessed from outside.

title: “Excellent location - but could do with a few touch-ups”
review_text:
Park royal collection marina bay is located at a very strategic spot in Singapore. It provides accessibility to the marina bay area which further expands into the many touristy areas around Singapore 

My honest opinion after staying here for the third time

- the check in is located at the 4th floor. But upon arrival at the check-in time (2.30pm) we realized that the counter for club room check-in privileges was not manned. The whole point of getting the club room was to have a more prestigious entry to the hotel but we ended up waiting for quite some time before we can actually check in through the normal counters. The lady handling our check in could have been friendlier (it always helps to smile) and more helpful (we had to ask her for benefits since we were GHA members instead of being prompted by her).

3. Improvements to the room
- upon checking in, we found a old box of chocolates addressed to the previous guest. Probably this was missed out by housekeeping. We also see that the showers could do with abit of touch up as the shower points showed some signs of mould and rust. The view from our room isn't exactly the best (towards suntec city). Ask for a view towards Esplanade instead.

4. Great architecture
- in our opinion, the best experience wasn't in the room but at the lobby / breakfast area. This hotel integrates nature as part of its whole structure and it was really nice to see some greenery 

We'll still come back since the overall experience was great less a few small area of improvement

My four-night stay was initially quite comfortable until the last night, when I found a cockroach in the room. It was 1:40 a.m., and almost 2 a.m. by the time a staff came. He managed to catch it and explained it was a German roach. I am absolutely terrified of bugs, and did not expect to find a cockroach at a five-star hotel. The staff offered to allow me to move to another room, but as a former travel writer I knew that one roach in one room means that there are more throughout the entire building. It was also past 2 am, and I was extremely tired. I also had a very, very important business meeting the following day. I ended up being unable to sleep that night and feeling very tired for my meeting.

The staff who caught the roach also offered to help with late checkout, but I had already requested it earlier that day. I would have loved to pack everything up and leave first thing in the morning, but I could not do so due to my schedule. I slept very poorly and was very, very tired for my last day of meetings.

During checkout, I called for help with my bags as I had quite a lot, but it took almost one hour for someone to come. I also did not have enough time to complain about the roach situation during checkout because I had another meeting before my late-night flight. The manager apologized about the cockroach and offered a complimentary ride to the airport and a 50% discount on incidentals. My room service bill was around $180, so he offered $90 off. I wanted to argue further that this was not enough, but I did not have time before my last appointment.

title: “Disappointing Stay at Amara Sanctuary – Zero Stars”
review_text:
Our recent stay at Amara Sanctuary was nothing short of frustrating, and if zero stars were an option, that’s what we would give.

We arrived at 2 PM, completed all the paperwork, and went for a walk since check-in was at 3 PM. When we returned at 3:20 PM to collect our room key, the receptionists were chatting among themselves, completely ignoring us. After standing there for 10–15 minutes, I politely asked for an update, only to receive a rude response: “Can you wait for a moment?”—as if I hadn’t already been waiting. After arguing, one of them finally handed over the room key without any apology or explanation about the hotel facilities, WiFi, or anything else.

When we reached our room, we discovered that instead of the king-sized bed we had requested (especially since we had a child with us), we were given a room with two single beds. I immediately called the reception, and they casually said, “We will see what we can do.” Hours passed with no update. I asked again at 6 PM—still no solution. At 8 PM, while heading for dinner, I reminded them again, only to get the same response: “We are looking into it.” I asked to join beds atleast. 

By 10:30 PM, when we returned with our sleepy child, the beds were still not joined. When I asked again, the staff lazily said they would do it “in some time.” At this point, we were exhausted and just wanted to sleep. Finally after a heated arguement they joined beds. sleeping in the middle of two pushed-together beds was extremely uncomfortable.

The next morning, breakfast was another disaster. We arrived at 8 AM to find a long queue, with most food items already finished. There was barely any staff attending to the buffet, and refills were painfully slow. We waited until 9:15 AM, only to be told, “You can take away your food to your room; we don’t have space, and we close at 10.” No apology, no proper service—just pure mismanagement.

Overall, our stay was a complete disappointment. Poor customer service, unhelpful and rude staff, lack of communication, uncomfortable sleeping arrangements, and a terrible breakfast experience. Definitely not worth the price. We won’t be returning and do not recommend this hotel to anyone.

title: “Relaxing getaway”
review_text:
Here is my review of our 4D3N stay at Amara sanctuary 

1. room - decor is very dated, but clean, water pressure is good and come with the basic necessities. A tv that doesnt have any good channels and mostly doesnt work, so i watched tiktok throughout my stay. The cushion for the arm chair is very used, no support at all. But in general, the room is clean and the bed is firm & comfortable. Sound proofing is extremely bad coz im constantly woken up by people talking at the corridor coz there are just some people that dont know how to be more considerate. Was told that i had the sea view room but all i could see out my window are coconut trees. Every morning, there is also a rooster that never fails to wake u up regardless of what time u sleep. There is a snack area where kitkat & oreo are replenish daily, likewise for the drinking water. 
2. Breakfast - very standard n minimal international breakfast. The kuehs are yummy. However, on the last day of my breakfast, i realised the crab stick that i took from the noodle section still has the plastic film/wrapper on and i actually cook that with my noodles without realising, so the kitchen team might wanna do a double check on that. Other than that, service from the staff are always friendly and prompt. 
3. Restaurant - there is an on site restaurant and we had 2 of our dinnners there. Food is great and the service rendered by jennifier is impeccable.  
4. Facilities - a gym and 2 swimming pools. We din check out the gym but the pools were kinda disappointing. The dream pool is for kids so it was rather small. The skypool is also small and not sure if it was due to the rain, the water was murky and doesnt look inviting at all. So we din use the pool during our stay. 

Overall the stay is relaxing and enjoyable. However, there was a little hiccup while checking-in as our reserved rooms [3 rooms, 2 connected rooms with twin beds] werent available even though we were promised that these will be available back when we booked. we specifically requested for twin beds coz our group required that. But, we were given 3 rooms with king sized beds instead. Special thanks to shaz from front desk to do a complimentary upgrade so that we can have 1 room with separate beds. 
Also, special shoutout to the staff uncle liu that drove us to and back from the ultra golf on the buggy, apparently he is the only one licensed to drive out of the hotel area. And the rest of the staff at the hotel, they are all very welcoming and helpful.

title: “Convenient and Clean”
review_text:

- good location, close to Lavender station, many shops around
- new and clean room, excellent hygiene feel
- shower facility itself is great (temperature, water pressure and shower type)
- bed is fine
- not too crowded
- reception staff genuine, friendly and helpful (way above expectations for this category of hotel in Singapore) - appreciated!

Negative points:
- room A/C is automatically set to 20 degrees, too cold to sleep (only fan or turn off - too hot to sleep)
- there is no shower curtain between the shower and toilet, so the toilet area gets completely wet
- room cleaning was not done on the first day since I did not put the "please clean" sign on the door
- soundproofing is not great
- room is small (compact yet functional, it's okay if you weren't expecting a big room)

This time I found a very good deal, so overall the value for money was justified, and I am happy. Especially refreshing to see all the genuinely kind staff at the hotel, thank you!!

I understand that it’s a villa, so insects are to be expected, but there was a small cockroach scare in the living room. The pool also had a few bugs floating around by morning. One minor inconvenience was that the doorbell wasn’t very audible, so we didn’t hear it ring and were later told by the staff that they had been trying to get our attention. The buggy service was convenient, though it once took around 20 minutes to arrive, by which time we could’ve walked back ourselves if it hadn’t been so dark.

Breakfast was decent, though nothing particularly special. There was no curry available for prata, which felt a bit odd. The indoor carpark was convenient since there was no gantry, but it was quite small like 20 lots. The outdoor carpark had another 10 or so? If there had been a wedding event, there definitely wouldn’t have been enough lots for hotel guests. Fortunately, we were allowed to park in the VIP spaces till there was space in the carpark. 

Spa (Swedish massage) was relaxing, had a 25% off for weekend treatments.

Overall, service was still good, with mostly friendly staff who tried their best to assist whenever possible.

title: “Exceptional”
review_text:
1. The service staff are very good, from the front door receptionist to the check-in counter and all other departments. Upon arrival, I was greeted by a polite receptionist who helped carry my luggage to the room. Although there were a lot of people checking in, I didn’t have to wait too long. I checked in with a female staff member at the check-out counter, and her service was excellent with a clear and easy-to-understand English accent. 
2. The room is as advertised, clean, with a beautiful view of the fountain, Suntec Mall, and the National Stadium from the 17th floor. The view is stunning. The noise from the street isn’t loud, but sometimes at night, loud cars may be heard. I like that there is a hairdryer both in the bathroom and outside, which is very convenient.
3. The hotel is new and clean, located in a great area in the heart of the city, easy to travel to, close to the mall and MRT. The bus stop is not far either. There are several elevators, and you don’t have to wait long. The security system is very good; you can only access the floor you are staying on. The hotel is just as beautiful as in the pictures.

For this stay, I would like to make some recommendations:
1. Breakfast has a variety of options, but mostly only chicken and not much pork. Since I traveled with my grandmother who has gout and doesn’t eat chicken, there were limited food options for us.
2. I stayed in a room that had an adjoining door, and on the second night, the occupants in the adjacent room were talking loudly around midnight, which made it hard to sleep.

Overall, I was very impressed, especially with the service, location, cleanliness, and beauty of the hotel. It’s a pity that I didn’t take many photos of the accommodation during this trip; it really is very beautiful. If I have the opportunity, I will return to stay here again.

title: “Luggage storage or early check-in, etc..!”
review_text:
It was difficult to find the entrance to the mall since I couldn't go to the hotel lobby during the F1 period, but this is a special situation, so it's fine..! Once you enter the lobby, the staff immediately takes your luggage and gives you a storage card. You can comfortably leave your luggage and go to the lobby to check in. I arrived one or two hours earlier than the 3 PM check-in, but they gave me the key right away..! I was exhausted from the unexpectedly hot Singapore, but I took a comfortable break before heading out for dinner.

The hotel lobby is beautiful and grand, and I enjoyed a very hearty breakfast every day in front of the lobby.

It was nice that I could take a break at the café on the opposite side without ordering separate drinks, and the staff continuously moved my luggage to the lobby, making it very convenient. There were plenty of elevators compared to the number of rooms, and they were fast, so I hardly had to wait.

The pool is great for relaxing during the day, but it is really beautiful at night! Even if you don't swim, I recommend you go at night, take some photos, and have a cocktail at the bar next door.

I don't speak English, but they explained everything slowly, so I didn't feel uncomfortable even when I had questions.~
